reviews.t: Great quality for a fantastic price.
reviews.x: Perfect size for my 2 year old. Great quality. I ordered the smaller bows when she was a baby and they were great too. When she gets bigger, I absolutely plan on buying the next size up.

I bought these for my 1 year old, 3 year old, and 5 year old. They have held up amazingly! My girls are rough and they have yet to destroy any of these bows. They also stay in exceptionally well. I would definitely recommend these to anyone that loves bows! Beautiful colors and I love that there are 2 of every color! Perfect for pigtails!

I'm really pleased with the bows. They are definitely good value for my money. There are colors, 2 of each. The clips are partially wrapped with the center ribbon, secured by glue. They seem to be sturdy.

reviews.t: Don't turn back! Worth the ltw night shopping binge purchase!
reviews.x: These are great bows! I was not sure because of the cost;however,they are sturdy and made very well. I have 2 bows for every hairstyle.  I would actually give these as a gift to anyone. ;no shame attached! Don't turn back purchase now! Also, the ribbon quality is really astounding for the price of this combo of bow's.

reviews.t: So cute. Bang for your buck.
reviews.x: These are so cute and they're pretty sturdy so far the bow fabric is really nice to the touch. I'm a braid stylist n love adding a little bit of love with accessories and hair jewelry n these are perfect !
These bows are great for younger girls. The alligator clips hold great. They aren't extremely durable, but for the price it is definitely well worth the purchase!
Great colors and quantity but not durable at all. My one year old literally tugs at it once and the clip/bow separates with ease 🤷🏾‍♀️ No longer usable and
These bows are the best thing. I love all of the colors! I especially love that there are two of each.
These bows are great.  I paid almost $5 for one at a store in my hometown.

They are super cute, all the colors are as pictured. They are also very durable, I use them on my 2 year old that has a lot of hair. They last the entire day without falling out. They bow also holds up and hasn’t come out of its fold. Usually when my 2 year old would try to take the bows out herself she would pull the ribbon and out comes the bow fold. Luckily, thus far they have not! Awesome Bows and I will be buying more again really soon!

reviews.t: Poor quality, I would not buy these again
reviews.x: [[VIDEOID:e3d6cd99bfefc4de1abecf6649d7a2ad]] I got these in today, as I take them out of the package some bows were uneven. Some bows have glue sticking all over the top. 2 of the bows have clips that glued shut. I did not take pictures of all of the uneven ones. There were too many uneven ones to take pictures of them all. Clip on red one in the video was glued shut.

My Daughters Absolutely LOVE this Bows. It’s so hard for me to find a Good Quality made bow as they are always falling apart I’ve bought this last year and with school coming up I Just Had to buy them Again and will definitely stay a loyal  customer 👌 I love how it comes in Twos for the fact that I have two girls. Can’t beat that ♥️ Highly recommend

Sturdy bows that cover all basic colors you could need for an outfit. Perfect set for twins because I could get two of each color so it saved me even more money! The alligator clips with the teeth stay well in my girls' slippery hair and are harder for them to yank out themselves.

I love this variety. The size was exactly what I needed.  I did not have a single bow fall apart or a strong smell, as I have seen in other reviews. We have worn about half of the bows so far, with no issues. I wish I could find this same set in darker colors. So cute!

The ribbon itself is nice but paired with very poor construction and low quality clip. Some of the bows came with the clip part bent. Some of them are put together lopsided and all of them have a tendency to start coming apart with very little use.

For my daughter's 4th birthday I wanted to buy her ALOT of hair bows and this was the best set I could find for the cheapest. She likes things big and flashy and these are the perfect size for her head without being too big.

Omg I must say this is the best investment I’ve made when searching for these Beautiful Hair Bows for my Daughter’s & GrandDaughter. And The Quality is Great and As Described with Fast Shipping. From This Seller :Thanks

reviews.t: No Bow, no go!! These are always a go!!
reviews.x: Love these bows, perfect for pigtails. Love the color and quality. Comes with no slip clips which are great for fine hair and 15 month olds who usually pull them out. Ordered the larger ones for the big sister!!

Love these bows, great quality for the price and a nice variety of colors. I ordered the 4.5 inch and they are perfect for my 2 year old. Not too small, but not obnoxiously, gigantic looking on her head.
These bows are awesome. Beautiful ribbon and sturdy clips. Can’t beat the price. You’ll get some colors that you may not need but it’s still a great deal as compared to buying one now in a store.
My daughter is 4. Not too big not to small. Just right and soooooooooo cute!! Cant beat the price either. Assorted colors are a plus!! They come in a nice bag too for storage. Love it!!
i thought that they were going to be a little bigger however i think they are probably true to size and that it was me who had a misconception.  they look very cute in my girls hair.

reviews.t: Just as good as any other hair bow at other hair accessories retail stores
reviews.x: These hair bows are just as good as any hair that can be purchased at any retailer that sells hair accessories. I particularly like the fact that you get so much more for the money.
It was advertised to 2 each of 15 colors - a total of 30 bows.  I did receive 30 bows but not 2 of each color.  I only received 1 light purple and 3 yellow bows.
These hair bows are super adorable and very durable. They look so cute in my girls' hair. The colors are BEAUTIFUL!! Will definitely order more when i need to.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the bows as good value for the money and great quality for the price.
Many customers highlight that the bows are sturdy and durable, holding up well even with rough toddlers.
Customers love the color variety and the fact that each color comes in twos.
Some reviewers report poor construction and durability, with clips separating, glue issues, or bows coming apart.
The alligator clips are noted to stay in hair well, even on slippery hair and active toddlers.
